name: Clay
summary: Data enrichment and AI research platform for go-to-market teams.
description: Clay combines over a hundred data providers with AI research agents to find and enrich leads and automate personalized outbound workflows in a spreadsheet-like interface. It is widely used by growth and sales teams to build targeted lists. A free plan is available, and paid plans add credits, integrations and CRM sync; Clay also runs a creators partner programme.
